name: Avalon le Fae
overview: Lostbelt No. 6: Avalon le Fae is the sixth major story chapter in the "Cosmos in the Lostbelt" arc of the mobile RPG Fate/Grand Order. Written by series creator Kinoko Nasu, it is highly praised by the player community for its massive scale, deep dark fantasy worldbuilding, and emotionally complex narrative.
